mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 8.5 percentage points, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates broad economic contraction in housing and labor markets, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST decline and UNRATE rise fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS < 1.0% periods, CPIAUCSL rising does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550 thousand units, it signals residential construction contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 550 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 0.3pp in 3 months) indicates policy response to labor market deterioration, signaling economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE rise fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST < 550), rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates resilient consumer spending that offsets housing weakness, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In HOUST < 550 periods, RSAFS rising fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
